steps.title: Analyze and Parse Project Build Failure Log
steps.description: Examine the build log to isolate the AAPT error indicating 'match_height' layout_width attribute compatibility issue.

steps.title: Identify Faulty Layout Parameter in activity_main.xml
steps.description: Locate the ScrollView element in activity_main.xml containing the invalid 'match_height' value.

steps.title: Correct ScrollView layout_width
steps.description: Update 'match_height' layout_width property in ScrollView root element of activity_main.xml to 'match_parent'.

steps.title: Verify Linear Layout and View Bounds
steps.description: Validate nested content containers and edit text dimensions within activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Examine MainActivity Source Code
steps.description: Verify view bindings and event click listeners align perfectly with the updated activity_main.xml identifiers.

steps.title: Audit PDF Sharing and Export Procedures
steps.description: Review StrictMode policy overrides and safe file output streams for local storage processing.

steps.title: Review AndroidManifest.xml Definitions
steps.description: Ensure launcher configuration, application labels, theme configurations, and namespace imports are flawless.

steps.title: Optimize build.gradle Configuration
steps.description: Verify compile and target SDK 34 specifications, and remove unnecessary third-party packages.

steps.title: Audit App Metadata Manifest
steps.description: Validate app-meta.json file contains correct matching metadata configurations.

steps.title: Building PDF Creator Pro
steps.description: Execute native Gradle compilation tasks to build, verify, and package the debug application APK.
